title: Medicine and Health Skeleton v1
description: Coverage skeleton for the medicine-and-health continent (round 2, single-depth-first, CPO decision (33) 2026-06-12): field/subfield two-level node set under domain:medicine-and-health. Gate schemes = LCC class R + UDC class 61 (captured-sources.md, baseline 2026-06-12); cross-checks = OECD FORD 3 + MeSH H02/H02.403 (PhySH absent for medicine). Orchestrator pre-captured all four series before generation (decision (30) NS precedent). The seed_entities list is the orchestrator's coverage target; the generator applies the section-12 skeleton standard to decide keep/absorb/level and flags boundary cases. Subfield level assignment in seeds is provisional — the generator/QC rules per the dual criterion.

include: Medicine-and-health field and subfield coverage skeleton (nodes only)

Gate-anchored fields: own LCC R subclass (RA public health, RB pathology, RC internal medicine, RD surgery, RE ophthalmology, RF otorhinolaryngology, RG ob/gyn, RJ pediatrics, RK dentistry, RL dermatology, RM pharmacology/therapeutics, RS pharmacy, RT nursing) and/or own UDC 61x division

Clinical sub-specialties under LCC RC / UDC 616.x as subfields (cardiology 616.1, oncology 616-006, gastroenterology 616.3, endocrinology 616.4, nephrology, pulmonology 616.2, hematology, rheumatology, infectious-diseases 616.9, geriatrics)
Surgical sub-specialties under LCC RD as subfields (orthopedic, neurosurgery, plastic, cardiothoracic, urology)
Public-health subfields (epidemiology RA648.5-767, biostatistics, environmental-health RA565-600, occupational-medicine RC963-969, health-policy-and-management RA393-418, global-health)
medical-physics as a NEW native medicine field (LCC R895-920) — transferred from natural sciences per decision (30); reconcile against any prior NS-dropped record
psychiatry (UDC 616.89) and neurology (UDC 616.8) as fields by institutional independence over LCC RC shelving (shelving-not-hierarchy precedent), flagged ambiguous for QC

alternative/non-mainstream systems (LCC RV/RX/RZ): alternative-medicine field + homeopathy/chiropractic/naturopathy subfields, with academic_status tags (non_academic / contested / established as appropriate)
Wikidata QID resolution for identity and external_ids
exclude: Edges and relations (skeleton-first: dots before lines; part_of skeleton edges are a separate batch)
Level-3 concepts, persons, works — and ALL clinician/researcher person nodes (living-person strict, special discipline 1)

Re-proposing any existing /data node: domain:medicine-and-health (Q11190), subfield:physiology (Q521), subfield:anatomy (Q514), subfield:immunology (Q101929), field:biomedical-engineering (Q327092) — reconcile to existing IDs; these get medicine section-13 membership in a separate edge/resolution task, not new nodes

Basic/preclinical sciences whose home is life-sciences: anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, microbiology, immunology stay life-sciences-home (LCC QH/QP/QR) — medicine gets section-13 dual membership only, not a duplicate node (biostatistics is the exception: medicine-home per section-12 ruling 2026-06-11)
Veterinary medicine (MeSH H02.956 — agriculture/veterinary continent, FORD 4.3)
Disease/condition nodes (LCC RC organ-disease ranges describe the subfield's object, not the discipline — model the discipline, e.g. cardiology, not 'heart disease')

allowed_public_sources.notes: CC0. Resolver verifies the unverified training-knowledge QID hints in the proposal and fills missing QIDs. Medical homonym traps (calculus, etc.) — multi-signal, never label-match.
External-link / source-resolution pointer only. Never store or cache article bodies.

forbidden_sources.reason: External links only; never store article text or treat as primary evidence (project hard constraint).
No cloud LLM API calls, SDKs, or keys anywhere in repo tooling/build/CI (project hard constraint).
No scraping or crawling of third-party sites; resolvers use declared public APIs only.

notes: Gate = UDC class 61 + LCC class R (captured 2026-06-12, captured-sources.md). Cross-checks = OECD FORD 3 (3.1-3.5) + MeSH H02/H02.403. PhySH is absent for medicine (NS-only) — MeSH replaces it as the discipline scheme.

Section-12 skeleton modeling standard (docs/data-foundry.md section 12) is a mandatory generator input. Dual criterion: (a) major division in a gate scheme (UDC/LCC) AND (b) department/society/journal/degree-track community presence. Absorb refinements of a kept node serving the same community (record as v2 re-split candidate). Flat two-level (field/subfield) for node levels; edge depth is free.

Boundary pre-assignments (special discipline 3): basic medicine (physiology, anatomy, biochemistry clinical side) is life-sciences home with a medicine section-13 dual candidacy; microbiology/immunology stay life-sciences home (QR), medicine section-13 interface only. biostatistics is medicine-home (section-12 biostatistics precedent). These four existing nodes (physiology Q521, anatomy Q514, immunology Q101929, biomedical-engineering Q327092) are reconciled-against excludes — section-13 edges in a separate task, never new nodes.
Living-person strict (special discipline 1): discipline nodes only; no person nodes this round.

medical-physics: NEW native medicine field (LCC R895-920), transferred from natural sciences per decision (30). PhySH absent, MeSH present — cross-check accordingly. Distinct referent from radiology (applied physics discipline vs clinical imaging specialty).

Medical QID homonym traps: dental 'calculus' (works 1.05M), Q141495/Q11216-class OpenAlex duplicate-link anomalies (decisions (19)(38)) — resolver and QC use multi-signal triangulation, never label-string matching. Hint-laundering machine sweep is mandatory at QC (sessions 8-16 pattern).
